## Bio

Hi, my name is Surafel! I am a third year statistics and data science student at UT Austin, also pursuing the Programming and Computation certificate. I am currently doing research on sensitivity analysis methods for assumption violations in surrogate marker validation, and my research interests are in causal inference. In my free time, I enjoy cooking, watching movies, and reading.<br>
